mod.overview: Paintball (v.Tactical_XCal) by +]-[+Armageddon+] and +]-[+WorstAim+] (Team Hybrid, March 2004) converts Tribes into a grounded, one-hit-elimination tactical paintball shooter. Jetpacks, vehicles, heavy armors, and base Tribes weapons are stripped out so everyone moves on foot in a single Player Suit with a two-gun limit, leaning on cover, camo props, smoke screens, and flashbangs across standard CTF, C&H, D&D, and F&R missions. Players spawn with 5-second SafeSpawn protection and can customize their spawn loadout or toggle marker fire modes (Full-Auto, Burst, Semi-Auto, Safety) directly from the TAB XCalibur Options menu, while inventory stations auto-eject campers. Expanded static-shape and elevator packs also support custom paintball arenas and obstacle courses.
notes: Single ground-based class: Every player uses LightArmor (Player Suit, maxDamage 0.66) with a 2-weapon limit, crouch support, and jetpacks effectively disabled (jetForce 1, maxEnergy 1.0, maxJetForwardVelocity 1.0). Forward/back/strafe speeds are 16/8/7 with jumpImpulse 70.

One-shot paintball lethality and canisters: All 12 standard markers fire 500 m/s Blaster-type paintballs at 1.0 damage against a 5x Blaster damage scale, so any direct hit splats the target instantly. Each marker holds 250 rounds and reloads via 1 spare 250-round canister (Clip::onUse or auto-reload on empty, taking 0.5 s on ADG MiniMag, 2.03 s on WarMachine Assault 80, and 3.0-3.03 s on others).

Heavy specialty weapons: Beyond the 12 rapid/precision markers (ADG MiniMag, Angel, Autococker, Dragun, Inferno, Intimidator, Mongoose, PsychoBallistic Lightning, Smart Parts Vision, Spyder E-99, Tippmann 98 Sniper, WarMachine Assault 80), players can carry the AWPT Shotgun (12 pellets per shot, 24 shells), AWTP Bunker Thumper (6 rockets, 6.5 m splash), or M-79 PB Gren Launcher (10 shells, hold trigger to charge Pump Gage range up to 250 m).

TAB menu fire modes and spawn favorites: Press TAB for XCalibur Options to open LCD Options (switch equipped marker between Full-Auto, 3Shot-Burst, 6Shot-Burst, Semi-Auto, and Safety on Angel/Mongoose/Spyder/WarMachine, or Semi-Auto/Safety on the rest) and Spawn In Favs (configure spawn marker, field item, camo suit, and addon without visiting a station). Default spawn equips ADG MiniMag with 250 paintballs and 1 spare canister.

Tactical grenades, mines, and packs: Inventory sells Paint Grenades (max 4, 2 s fuse, bursts into 40 PaintSplat rounds), Smoke Bombs (max 1, 27 s smoke screen, 1 active globally), Flash Bangs (max 3, ~7.2 s screen blind and forces flag drop), Antipersonnel Mines (max 1 carried, 35 per team), Flash Light and Laser Scope packs (+20 sensor suppression when toggled on), 5 Camo Suits, and the single-use Supply Pack.

Spawn protection, station ejection, and bans: Players spawn with 5-second SafeSpawn invulnerability (faded, auto-repairing, weapon holstered until expired). Inventory stations automatically launch lingering players off the pad after 10-45 seconds ($Paintball::StationKickTime). MediumArmor, HeavyArmor, all vehicles, all base Tribes weapons, and Beacons are removed or set to $InvList 0; standalone ammo and clip items cannot be bought directly at inventory stations ($InvList 0), and remote stations only dispense Paint Grenades and Smoke Bombs.

Chat commands, bots, and scoring: Public chat commands include !whereis <player>, !listadmins, !stop (halts player velocity), and !V.XC; team-kills penalize 5 points. Bot/AI mission drones (ai.cs) spawn in marmor armed with Spyder markers on non-DM missions, and CTF/C&H/D&D/F&R matches end with a Hybrid Score System summary listing score, kills, deaths, and flag captures.

Additional station and team bans: Disabled at Inventory Stations ($InvList = 0): AngelAmmo (Weapon_Angel.cs), AngelClip (station.cs), AutoCockerAmmo (Weapon_AutoCocker.cs), AutoCockerClip (station.cs), AWPTShotgunAmmo (Weapon_AWPTShotgun.cs), Beacon (station.cs), BunkerAmmo (Weapon_BunkerThumper.cs), DeltaAmmo (Weapon_ADG_MiniMag.cs), DeltaClip (station.cs), DragunAmmo (Weapon_Dragun.cs), DragunClip (station.cs), InfernoAmmo (Weapon_Inferno.cs), IntimidatorAmmo (Weapon_Intimidator.cs), M79Ammo (Weapon_M79.cs), MongooseAmmo (Weapon_Mongoose.cs) (+9 more).

LightArmor.summary: Player Suit (LightArmor) — the sole playable armor class, stripped of jetpacks for grounded tactical paintball combat.
notes: Male (larmor) and female (lfemale) variants share identical stats: maxDamage 0.66, forward speed 16, backward speed 8, side speed 7, jumpImpulse 70, canCrouch true, and a 2-weapon carry limit.
Jetpacks are effectively disabled (jetForce 1, maxEnergy 1.0, jetEnergyDrain 2, maxJetSideForceFactor 0.0, maxJetForwardVelocity 1.0), keeping all movement grounded.
Blaster damage scale is 5.0, making every standard paintball hit an instant one-shot elimination.

M79.summary: M-79 PB Gren Launcher — a variable-range paintball grenade launcher charged by holding the trigger.
notes: Carries up to 10 shells with no spare clip canisters; refills via AmmoStation or Supply Pack.
Holding fire increments the Pump Gage up to 250 m and releasing fires a shell matched to that range (8 m explosion radius, 5.0 Blaster damage).
Carrying a Laser Scope (TLPack) halves the charge rate from 2 to 1 per tick for finer distance control.

FlareGrenade.summary: Flash Bang (FlareGrenade) — tactical stun grenade that blinds opponents and forces flag drops.
notes: Carries up to 3 per player and detonates on a 2-second fuse (10 m radius, $BangDamageType).
Blinded victims have their HUD flooded by sun-glare overlays for 9 ticks (~7.2 seconds) and automatically drop any carried flag.

SmokerGrenade.summary: Smoke Bomb (SmokerGrenade) — deploys a sustained smoke screen for cover during pushes or flag escapes.
notes: Carries 1 per player; after a 3-second delay it emits 270 smoke bursts over 27 seconds.
Globally throttled ($GrenadeIsSmoking) so only one smoke bomb can emit clouds at a time across the server to prevent lag.

SuPack.summary: Supply Pack (SuPack) — single-use field resupply pack that tops off paintballs, spare canisters, and mines.
notes: First activation mounts the pack; activating it while mounted consumes it after 0.4 seconds to refill carried weapon ammo (250 paintballs, 10 M-79, 6 Bunker, or 24 Shotgun), 1 spare clip per marker, and 1 mine.
